name: array-mutability-test-f73ad51ac1/array-mutability-open-sealed-p.bal
reason: The case uses supported local declarations, a list constructor, array aliasing and indexed assignment. The inferred fixed-length array int[*] retains its length of four when assigned to an int[] variable; assigning index 4 through that alias must panic rather than extend the fixed-length value. This is ordinary array member-assignment behavior within the supported constructs, with no applicable subset restriction.
test_design_notes: The @panic annotation asserts the bounds panic from open[4] = 5; there are no command-line argument or output assertions.
